scope: Required retention and projected tube roof bearing for full 168 prior signed rows. Each upper crossmember has a key directly over its roof. Each rear sill needs a positive offset pedestal down to its narrower rail. Prying factor is a sizing hypothesis. Thread stripping, eventual distributed planar pressure/fatigue, metal form, real screw seating, assembly ordering and lateral motion require physical/independent evidence.
